ingredients.name: root vegetables, sliced, such as carrots, turnips or radishes

steps.instruction: Place 2 sliced onions and 1 pound of sliced root vegetables in a large stock pot.
Add 1 pound of sliced lean beef on top.
Simmer over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring well.
Add 2 cups of vegetable broth and salt to taste.
steps.spoken: When the beef and vegetables look cooked, add 2 cups of vegetable broth and salt to taste.

steps.instruction: Bring the soup back to a simmer, then serve.
